title.en: Xiaowen: moving a court, changing its language
title.zh: 孝文帝：迁都与制度转变

summary.en: Emperor Xiaowen ruled a Northern Wei court shaped by Tuoba traditions and the institutions of the people it governed. Moving the capital from Pingcheng to Luoyang in 493–494 made that negotiation visible in geography. Changes in language, dress and court practice accompanied the move; adopting Chinese forms did not simply erase the dynasty’s earlier history. Buddhist patronage supplied another language of authority. At Longmen, sculpture drew on connections between northern and southern artistic traditions. His reign thus links political decisions to the lives of officials, craftspeople and worshippers who inhabited an increasingly interconnected cultural world.
summary.zh: 孝文帝统治的北魏朝廷，既承袭拓跋传统，也面对被统治地区已有的制度。493—494年由平城迁往洛阳，使这种调整落实在都城的选择上。语言、服饰和朝廷礼制的变化伴随迁都展开；采用汉文化形式，并不意味着此前的王朝历史被抹去。佛教赞助提供了另一种表达权威的方式。龙门石窟的造像体现南北艺术传统之间的联系。通过这一时期，可以把政治决策与官员、工匠、礼佛者的生活联系起来，观察制度和艺术如何共同参与文化的变化。

title.en: Yang Jian: rebuilding an imperial government

location.label: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

labelI18n.en: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

summary.en: Yang Jian founded the Sui in 581 and brought the southern Chen realm under his rule in 589. Reunification required more than a change of ruler: officials had to administer territories with different recent political histories. His government developed legal and administrative arrangements that the Tang would inherit, while canals helped connect resources and centers of power. Buddhist patronage also belonged to this project of rule. The short duration of the dynasty can obscure these institutional ambitions. Reading his reign beside that of his successor separates the work of consolidation from the military and construction pressures that later strained Sui government.
summary.zh: 杨坚于581年建立隋朝，589年灭陈，将南方纳入统治。统一不仅意味着更换君主，也意味着官员要治理政治经历不同的地区。他在位时发展的法律与行政安排，为唐朝提供了制度基础；运河工程则把资源产地与权力中心联系起来。对佛教的赞助同样是统治实践的一部分。隋朝国祚短暂，容易掩盖这些制度建设的意图。将文帝与继任者的统治相对读，可以区分前期整合的工作，与后来战争、营建给国家带来的压力。

title.en: Yang Guang: canals, campaigns and imperial demands
title.zh: 隋炀帝：运河、战争与帝国征发

summary.en: Yang Guang inherited a reunited empire and tried to make its resources move on an imperial scale. The Tongji Canal, ordered in 605, linked Luoyang with waterways toward the south by joining and enlarging existing channels. Transport and capital building became visible expressions of his government’s ambitions. Those ambitions also reached beyond the empire: the 612 campaign against Goguryeo ended in disaster. Heavy demands and rebellion undermined Sui rule, and the emperor was killed in 618. His reign connects infrastructure with the labor and political power needed to create it. The survival of a useful waterway does not, by itself, measure what its construction cost the people compelled to work.
summary.zh: 杨广继承了重新统一的帝国，试图以更大规模调动资源。605年下令开通的通济渠，利用并扩展既有河道，把洛阳与通往南方的水路连接起来。交通与都城营建成为其政务抱负的可见形式。这种抱负也伸向境外：612年进攻高句丽遭受惨败。沉重征发与叛乱动摇隋朝，皇帝于618年被杀。他的统治把基础设施与营造它所需的劳动、权力联系起来；一条水道后来继续使用，并不能单独衡量被征发者当时承担的代价。

title.en: Taizong: advice, conquest and imperial authority
title.zh: 唐太宗：纳谏、征服与皇权

location.label: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

summary.en: Li Shimin became Emperor Taizong in 626 after helping his father establish Tang rule. His government expanded imperial power through campaigns as well as administration. Yet the advice he prepared for his heir in 648 turns attention to a different problem: how should a ruler hear criticism and choose the people who govern? The text presents self-restraint and attention to counsel as duties of kingship. It is a statement of governing ideals by an emperor, with a particular audience and purpose. Placed beside the career of his general Li Jing, it shows how military success and the language of responsible rule worked together in the early Tang court.
summary.zh: 李世民帮助父亲建立唐朝后，于626年即帝位，是为唐太宗。战争与行政建设共同扩展了皇权，但他648年为继承者撰写的训诫，把注意力转向另一问题：君主应如何听取批评、选择治理国家的人？文中把节制自身与接受谏言视为君主的责任。这是一位皇帝面向特定读者表达的治国理想，具有明确的写作目的。与将领李靖的经历相对读，可以看到早唐朝廷如何把军事成就与负责治国的语言结合起来。

title.en: Li Jing: campaigns that enlarged early Tang power
title.zh: 李靖：扩展早唐权力的战事

location.label: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

labelI18n.en: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

summary.en: Li Jing’s career connects the wars that established Tang rule with campaigns beyond its northern and western frontiers. In 621 he helped defeat Xiao Xian’s regime around Jiangling. His forces later struck the Eastern Turkic leadership, contributing to its defeat in 630, and campaigned against Tuyuhun in 635. These were collective military operations involving other commanders, allied forces and defeated communities. Li Jing also held senior posts at court, where military achievement could become political authority. Later generations attached strategic wisdom to his name, but the campaigns can be studied without assuming that every military text attributed to him was actually his work.
summary.zh: 李靖的仕途把唐朝建立统治的战争，与其后向北方、西方拓展的战事联系起来。621年，他参与击败以江陵为中心的萧铣政权；630年，其军队打击东突厥统治者，参与东突厥的败亡；635年又出征吐谷浑。这些行动涉及其他将领、协同部队以及战败地区的社会，不能归结为一人的功业。李靖也在朝廷担任要职，军事成就因此转化为政治权威。后世把兵学智慧附着在他的名字上，但研究具体战事，并不需要预先认定所有托名兵书都出自其手。

title.en: Wu Zetian: making a claim to rule
title.zh: 武则天：建立统治的正当性

summary.en: Wu Zetian exercised power within the Tang court before taking the imperial title in her own Zhou dynasty in 690. Her career exposes the gendered assumptions built into dynastic rule: women could wield influence, but claiming the emperor’s position required a different public argument. Buddhist patronage, new political symbols and recruitment through examinations helped her build that argument and find supporters beyond established aristocratic circles. Her 674 policy proposals also addressed agriculture and official conduct. This was no general opening of office to women; the examination system remained male. Forced from power in 705, she left a reign whose institutions and reputation need to be distinguished from hostile anecdotes in later histories.
summary.zh: 武则天在唐廷掌握权力多年，690年以皇帝身份建立自己的周朝。她的经历显露了王朝统治中的性别门槛：女性可以施加影响，直接占据皇帝之位却需要另行建立公开的正当性。佛教赞助、新的政治象征与科举选才，帮助她寻找既有贵族圈子以外的支持者。674年的建言还涉及农业与官员行为。这并不意味着仕途向女性普遍开放，科举仍由男性参加。705年被迫退位后，她的制度实践与后世充满敌意的轶闻共同流传，阅读时应辨明两者的来源。

title.en: Xuanzong: a court of poets and a reign in crisis
title.zh: 唐玄宗：诗人的宫廷与统治危机

location.label: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

labelI18n.en: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

summary.en: Xuanzong’s reign is associated with the flourishing poetry, painting and court culture of the High Tang. Chang’an connected officials and artists with merchants, clerics and envoys from across Asia. Li Bai, Wang Wei and Du Fu nevertheless experienced that world from different social positions; a celebrated cultural era was not one shared biography. The rebellion beginning in 755 brought the court’s vulnerabilities into view and soon ended Xuanzong’s reign. The Tang itself survived. Reading his reign alongside the poems and mourning texts of its subjects moves beyond a tale of court splendor followed by collapse, revealing how cultural work continued through displacement and political change.
summary.zh: 玄宗在位时期常与盛唐诗歌、绘画及宫廷文化的兴盛相联系。长安使官员、艺术家与来自亚洲各地的商人、僧侣、使者相遇。但李白、王维、杜甫在这一世界中的社会位置并不相同，一个著名的文化时代也不是所有人共同的人生。755年爆发的叛乱暴露了朝廷的脆弱，随后结束了玄宗的统治，唐朝本身却继续存在。把他的在位时期与臣民留下的诗歌、祭文相对读，可以看见流离和政治变化中的文化创作，而不只是一条由繁华直落覆亡的叙事。

dateNote.en: 712–756 dates Xuanzong’s reign. The 755 rebellion is a turning point within it; neither date marks the end of Tang cultural production.
dateNote.zh: 712—756年为玄宗在位时段，755年叛乱是其中的转折；这些日期并不表示唐代文化创作的终止。

title.en: Wang Wei: a landscape made in words

location.label: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

labelI18n.en: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

summary.en: Wang Wei moved between official service, literary friendship and the imagined stillness of landscape. His examination success is conventionally dated to 721, although the sequence of his early career remains debated. Around 740 he acquired the Wangchuan estate, whose named sites became the subjects of twenty short poems. These poems invite attention to a changing view, a sound, or a moment when a place seems empty of people. His reputation as a painter extended that conversation between seeing and composing. The paintings now associated with Wangchuan are later versions, however; their relationship to a lost Tang work is part of the history of his reception, not proof of what his own brush produced.

summary.en: Li Bai’s poems turn travel, friendship and imaginative freedom into a compelling literary voice. His connections also placed him close to the risks of court politics. After a period associated with the Hanlin Academy, he met Du Fu in 744; their friendship links two writers whose verse would take markedly different forms. The rebellion drew Li Bai into the orbit of Prince Yong, and he was sentenced to exile. A pardon in 759 changed his fortunes again. His life can be approached through these documented reversals without turning every vivid poem into autobiography or treating the legends surrounding his drinking and death as established events.

title.en: Du Fu: writing a life inside a war
title.zh: 杜甫：在战争中书写人生

location.label: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

labelI18n.en: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

summary.en: Du Fu pursued an official career but is remembered through poems that give political upheaval a personal scale. Capture by rebels in 756 and escape in 757 placed him inside the crisis of the Tang court. In his poetry, anxiety about government sits beside hunger, separation, weather and close observation of other lives. The recurring wish to serve did not prevent him from recording suffering. His command of regulated verse also made form part of the achievement: carefully organized lines could hold conflicting feelings. Later readers called him a poet-historian, but his poems are situated acts of witness and composition, rather than a transparent chronicle of everyone’s experience.
summary.zh: 杜甫追求仕途，却以把政治动荡写入个人生活的诗篇留名。756年落入叛军之手、757年逃离，使他亲历唐廷危机。诗中的政局忧虑与饥饿、离别、天气以及对他人生活的细察相伴；希望报效朝廷，并没有阻止他记录苦难。他对律诗的驾驭也使形式成为成就的一部分：组织严密的诗句，可以容纳互相牵引的情感。后世视他为兼具史家眼光的诗人，但这些作品首先是特定处境下的见证与创作，不能作为所有人经历的透明年表。

title.en: Guo Ziyi: a wartime commander remembered as a family elder
title.zh: 郭子仪：从战时统帅到福寿长者

labelI18n.en: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

summary.en: Guo Ziyi’s career joined the military institutions of the Tang to the alliances on which its survival depended. From a military examination background, he became a Shuofang commander during the An–Shi rebellion and worked with Uyghur forces in recovering the two capitals. That wartime record later supplied a different cultural image. Paintings and drama transformed him into an elder surrounded by prosperous descendants at a birthday celebration. The general and the auspicious family figure belong to different kinds of evidence: one concerns warfare and service, the other the wishes that later households expressed through his name. Reading both reveals how a political career can become part of domestic ritual and visual culture.
summary.zh: 郭子仪的仕途把唐代军事制度与维系王朝的联盟联系起来。他出身武举，在安史战乱中担任朔方统帅，与回纥军队合作收复两京。这些战功后来又衍生出另一种文化形象：绘画与戏曲将他塑造成被显达子孙围绕、接受祝寿的长者。战时将领与吉祥家族形象属于不同层次的证据，前者涉及战争和任职，后者体现后世家庭借其名字表达的愿望。把两者一起阅读，可以观察政治生涯如何进入家居礼仪与视觉文化。

title.en: Yan Zhenqing: public duty and private mourning

summary.en: Yan Zhenqing’s calligraphy preserves more than an admired style. The draft he wrote in 758 for his nephew Yan Jiming recalls deaths in his family during the An–Shi rebellion. Corrections and additions make the work a record of writing under the pressure of grief, as well as a text shaped by loyalty to the Tang. Another surviving letter, assigned by scholars to about 775, belongs to a less ceremonial world of communication. These works place an official’s handwriting between public responsibility and personal need. They also invite different kinds of reading: the dated mourning text anchors an event, while the letter’s date depends on historical comparison.
summary.zh: 颜真卿的书法保存下来的，不只是受后世推崇的风格。758年为侄儿颜季明撰写的祭文，追忆安史战乱中的家族死亡。增补与涂改使它既是哀痛中写作的痕迹，也是带有忠于唐廷立场的文字。另一封传世信札，经学者据史事推定约作于775年，则属于较少礼仪色彩的通信世界。两类作品把官员的手迹置于公共责任与个人需要之间，也要求不同的阅读方式：祭文具有明确纪年，信札的年代则依赖历史比对。

title.en: Han Yu: an argument that cost an office
title.zh: 韩愈：以仕途为代价的论辩

location.label: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an

labelI18n.en: Chang'an, imperial capital represented by modern Xi'an
labelI18n.zh: 长安，以今西安代表的帝都

summary.en: Han Yu treated writing as a way to intervene in public life. After passing the jinshi examination in 792, he combined official service with advocacy of guwen, prose that drew on ancient models to argue contemporary questions. His 819 protest against the emperor’s welcome of a Buddhist relic brought exile to Chaozhou. The memorial defended Confucian political and social obligations through an aggressive rejection of Buddhism and its foreign origin. That argument reveals his commitments and exclusions; it does not describe Buddhist communities on their own terms. His career connects stylistic choices with the danger of speaking to power, while his varied poetry and prose extend beyond this single confrontation.

title.en: Bai Juyi: poetry between office and ordinary lives
title.zh: 白居易：官职与日常生活之间的诗歌

summary.en: Bai Juyi made the relationship between poetry and social responsibility a central concern. He entered the examination elite in 800, yet wrote verse that sought direct language and recognizable situations. The New Yuefu poems used literary form to question public conduct and draw attention to hardship. His own career moved between the capital and provincial office: banishment to Jiangzhou in 815 preceded appointments in Hangzhou and Suzhou. This movement brought the writer’s aspirations into contact with the routines of administration. His poems also explore friendship, aging and withdrawal. Reading both strands keeps the public critic and the person negotiating his own disappointments in the same life.

title.en: Liu Zongyuan: exile, landscape and obligations
title.zh: 柳宗元：贬谪、山水与责任

summary.en: Liu Zongyuan passed the jinshi examination in 793 and joined an ambitious circle of reforming officials. Its defeat in 805 sent him to Yongzhou in a marginal post. The political setback became the setting for essays, fables and landscape writing that continue to invite readers into questions of power and perception. His descriptions of small, overlooked places gave literary attention to terrain beyond the capital. Appointment as prefect of Liuzhou in 815 restored more active administrative responsibilities, but he died there in 819. His career belongs beside Han Yu’s in the development of classical prose, while their writings offer different approaches to politics, philosophy and religious life.

title.en: Zhao Kuangyin: a soldier becomes a founding emperor
title.zh: 赵匡胤：军人怎样成为开国皇帝

summary.en: Zhao Kuangyin founded the Song in 960 after a career in the military world of the tenth century. Later histories made his accession the beginning of an orderly, morally guided dynasty and emphasized his preference for civil government. The distance between the soldier and the sage-like founder is itself historical evidence. Charles Hartman’s study shows how familiar accounts of the coup and the banquet at which commanders supposedly surrendered power reached their settled forms much later, amid Southern Song concerns. Taizu’s life therefore opens two connected questions: how a military leader established a new dynasty, and how later writers fashioned an exemplary origin for the state they served.

summary.en: Fan Zhongyan’s public life connected local education with arguments about how the Song should recruit and supervise its officials. After his 1015 examination success, he served in provincial government; appointed to Suzhou in 1034, he established its prefectural school in 1035. Frontier service followed in 1040. Called to central responsibilities, he presented a reform program in 1043 addressing appointments, agriculture, labor obligations and military administration. Its political defeat and his dismissal in 1045 show that agreement about good government did not produce agreement about its methods. Remembered also for literary prose, Fan provides a link between the examination ideal and the contested practical business of running a state.

title.en: Ouyang Xiu: prose, poetry and the judgment of history
title.zh: 欧阳修：文章、诗歌与史家的判断

summary.en: Ouyang Xiu joined official life after passing the jinshi examination in 1030. His writing ranged across poetry, essays and historical narrative, making literary craft part of public intellectual work. As an advocate of classical prose, he helped renew a tradition associated with Han Yu, using models from the past to speak in a contemporary voice. His New History of the Five Dynasties also placed the recent age of competing regimes under a historian’s scrutiny. Official success, political disagreements and provincial service belonged to the same career. Reading his prose alongside his historical work asks how an author’s choices of language and example shape the moral judgments readers inherit.
summary.zh: 欧阳修于1030年进士及第后进入仕途，创作横跨诗歌、散文与史书，使文学技艺成为公共思想活动的一部分。他倡导古文，延续与韩愈相关的传统，借鉴古代文章来表达当代问题。《新五代史》又把不久前诸政权竞逐的时代置于史家审视之下。仕途成功、政治分歧与地方任职共同构成其生涯。把散文与史学著作相对读，可以追问作者怎样通过语言和事例的选择，塑造后来读者继承的道德判断。

title.en: Wang Anshi: turning a diagnosis into policy
title.zh: 王安石：从诊断问题到制定政策

summary.en: Wang Anshi brought experience in local administration to a program that made government responsible for changing economic conditions. His 1069 memorial on crop loans described the difficulty farmers faced between harvests and proposed public credit alongside grain management. The argument treated expensive private borrowing as a problem that institutions could address. It was a proposal, however, not a report proving that every borrower benefited. Opponents including Sima Guang disputed the direction and methods of reform. Wang’s withdrawal to Jiangning in 1076 ended one phase of political leadership, while the controversy continued. His career invites readers to connect a policy’s stated purpose with the officials, information and coercive power needed to carry it out.
summary.zh: 王安石把地方行政经验带入改革计划，主张政府主动改变经济条件。1069年的青苗奏议描述农民在收获之间面临的困难，提出以公共信贷配合粮食管理，把高成本私人借贷视为制度能够处理的问题。但奏议表达的是主张，并非证明每个借款者都受益的成效报告。司马光等反对者质疑改革的方向和方法。1076年退居江宁，结束了其政治领导的一个阶段，争论却继续存在。他的经历引导读者把政策目标与执行所需的官员、信息和强制力联系起来。

title.en: Sima Guang: governing through a history of decisions
title.zh: 司马光：以决策的历史思考治理

summary.en: Sima Guang passed the jinshi examination in 1038 and became an official whose political disagreements were inseparable from his historical work. He opposed Wang Anshi’s reforms and in 1070 sought to leave the capital. The Zizhi tongjian became the central undertaking of his years outside the court: a chronological history intended to make earlier political experience useful to rulers. Its organization encourages readers to follow decisions and consequences across successive regimes. Yet the selection of events and judgments is itself an argument about government. Reading Sima beside Wang brings two forms of public reasoning into conversation—a reform proposal directed at current conditions and a historical compilation directed at the uses of precedent.
summary.zh: 司马光1038年进士及第，其后的政治分歧与史学工作密不可分。他反对王安石变法，1070年请求离开京师。在朝廷之外，《资治通鉴》成为其主要事业：以编年形式整理历史，希望过去的政治经验能够帮助统治者。这样的组织方式让读者跨越政权更替，追踪决策与后果；而事件和评判的取舍，本身也表达治国观念。将司马光与王安石相对读，可以让两种公共论证展开对话：一方针对当下条件提出改革，一方通过编史讨论先例的用途。

title.en: Su Shi: making literature in the space left by exile
title.zh: 苏轼：在贬谪留下的空间中写作

summary.en: Su Shi passed the jinshi examination in 1057, but literary accomplishment did not protect him from political punishment. His Huangzhou years, beginning in 1080, produced works that turned a restricted life into an expansive conversation with history, landscape and friendship. The Former Ode on the Red Cliff was composed in 1082. When he copied it for Fu Yaoyu in 1083, his request that the friend keep it privately gives the surviving calligraphy a social setting beyond its later museum fame. Poetry, prose and handwriting meet in the same object. Su’s work makes it possible to follow both the imaginative freedom of composition and the practical caution of an official living after disgrace.
summary.zh: 苏轼1057年进士及第，文学成就却未能使他免于政治惩罚。1080年开始的黄州岁月，产生了把受限生活转化为与历史、山水和友情广泛对话的作品。1082年写成《前赤壁赋》，1083年为傅尧俞抄录时，又叮嘱友人私下收藏。这样的请求，使传世书迹拥有后来博物馆声名之外的交往背景。诗意、散文与书法汇聚在同一物件中。通过苏轼，可以同时追踪创作想象的自由，以及获罪官员在现实生活中的谨慎。

title.en: Yue Fei: a Song commander and the changing meaning of loyalty
title.zh: 岳飞：宋朝将领与忠诚含义的变化

summary.en: Yue Fei entered the Song army in 1122 and rose through warfare against the Jurchen Jin and other armed opponents. His military service belonged to a divided political world in which the Southern Song court had to decide between continued fighting and negotiated survival. Recall and imprisonment in 1141 ended his command; he was executed the following year. Later temples, stories and political movements made him an enduring figure of loyalty. Historian Yue Du emphasizes that the state he served was the Song dynasty, while modern readers have given that loyalty changing national meanings. Keeping the commander beside his later reputation helps explain both a twelfth-century conflict and the uses of its memory.
summary.zh: 岳飞1122年进入宋军，在对女真金朝及其他武装力量的战争中升任统帅。他所处的政治世界已经分裂，南宋朝廷需要在继续作战与议和求存之间作出选择。1141年被召回并入狱，结束了他的统军生涯，次年被处死。后来的祠庙、故事与政治活动不断把他塑造成忠诚典范。历史学者Yue Du强调，岳飞所效忠的国家是宋朝，而现代读者又为这种忠诚赋予不同的民族国家含义。将将领与后世声誉并读，有助于同时理解十二世纪冲突与历史记忆的用途。

title.en: Lu You: history in a poet’s everyday attention
title.zh: 陆游：诗人日常目光中的历史

location.label: Lower Yangzi, representative later-life literary setting

labelI18n.en: Lower Yangzi, representative later-life literary setting
labelI18n.zh: 长江下游，晚年文学生活的代表地区

summary.en: Lu You is often remembered for frustrated hopes of recovering the north for the Song. His surviving poetry also records gardens, weather, reading and the pleasures of small encounters. Stephen Owen observes that this large, chronologically arranged body of work can approach the texture of a diary. In the Sword-Gate poem dated 1172, the traveler sees himself as a figure in a poetic scene and questions the role he is playing. A plum-blossom poem dated 1202 turns delight into an impossible wish to be beside every flowering tree. These different scales of attention allow political desire and daily experience to inhabit the same writer’s life without reducing one to an illustration of the other.
summary.zh: 陆游常因希望宋朝恢复北方而不得的情怀被人记住，传世诗篇也记录园圃、天气、读书与细小相遇的趣味。Stephen Owen指出，这部篇幅庞大、依年代排列的诗作，具有接近日记的质感。1172年的剑门诗中，行旅者把自己看成诗意场景里的一个形象，反问所扮演的角色。1202年的咏梅诗则把喜爱化作不可能的愿望：分身到每一树花旁。不同尺度的关注，使政治愿望与日常经验能够存在于同一人生中，彼此又不只是对方的注脚。

title.en: Xin Qiji: crossing a political divide, writing across it
title.zh: 辛弃疾：越过政治分界，继续书写

summary.en: Xin Qiji came from Licheng in the north and entered Southern Song service in 1162. His career crossed a political boundary that remained central to his reputation as a writer. Office in Jiangyin was followed by a Jiankang appointment in 1168, linking literary ambition to the work and frustrations of provincial government. He became known for ci, lyrics composed to established tune patterns, and for the desire to recover the north. Later periods away from active office in Jiangxi formed another setting for his writing. The sequence of appointments is unevenly documented: local research can recover possibilities, but a newly proposed posting should not silently become a certain stop on his map.

title.en: Wen Tianxiang: resistance, captivity and a written legacy
title.zh: 文天祥：抵抗、囚禁与文字遗产

summary.en: Wen Tianxiang achieved first place in the 1256 imperial examination, entering the Southern Song elite through its most celebrated path. As Mongol armies advanced, examination honor gave way to the demands of resistance and negotiation. His 1276 appointment as a chief minister belonged to the court’s emergency; subsequent efforts to continue the struggle ended in captivity. By 1279 he was imprisoned in Dadu, where writing became a means of explaining the loyalty he refused to abandon. Executed in 1283, he was later commemorated in a shrine near his place of confinement. His surviving reputation joins political choices to the poems and prose through which a defeated official addressed future readers.
summary.zh: 文天祥1256年殿试第一，以最受推崇的科举道路进入南宋精英行列。蒙古军队推进之际，科名荣誉让位于抵抗与交涉的现实要求。1276年丞相任命属于朝廷危急中的应变，此后继续抗争的努力以被俘告终。至1279年，他被囚于大都，写作成为说明为何不愿放弃效忠的方式。1283年被处死后，后人在其囚禁地附近建祠纪念。他的声誉由政治选择与诗文共同构成，也让一位失败政权的官员得以向未来读者发言。

title.en: Genghis Khan: creating a new political order through conquest
title.zh: 成吉思汗：征服中的新政治组织

location.label: Mongolian heartland, representative setting of the 1206 assembly

summary.en: Genghis Khan’s elevation in 1206 joined a personal rise to the creation of a new Mongol political order. The assembly and title expressed authority across previously competing affiliations, while military organization made further expansion possible. Campaigns against the Tangut Xia in 1209 and the Jin capital in 1215 were followed by a Central Asian invasion beginning in 1219. Conquest brought alliances, forced submission and devastating violence; the movement of armies should not be mistaken for peaceful connection alone. His successors extended the empire after his death in 1227. The selected years follow the construction and exercise of power while leaving the disputed year of his birth unresolved.
summary.zh: 1206年成吉思汗地位的确立，把个人崛起与新的蒙古政治组织联系起来。大会和称号表达了跨越原有竞争关系的权威，军事组织又为进一步扩张提供条件。1209年对党项西夏、1215年对金朝都城的战争，随后连接到1219年开始的中亚入侵。征服包括联盟、被迫臣服和毁灭性暴力，军队的移动并不只是和平联系。1227年去世后，继承者继续扩张帝国。本条选取权力形成与运用的年代，不裁定存在争议的出生年份。

dateNote.en: 1206–1227 is a focus interval from the assembly to death, not a full lifespan. Campaign points represent named regions; 1219 dates the opening of a campaign, not the conquest date of every city.

title.en: Kublai Khan: governing a conquered realm
title.zh: 忽必烈：治理被征服的疆域

summary.en: Kublai Khan, a grandson of Genghis Khan, ruled through institutions as well as armies. The Yuan dynastic designation in 1271 and the capital at Dadu gave his authority a Chinese imperial form. Government offices, ritual and education were adapted to the needs of Mongol rule, while unequal treatment of different populations remained part of that order. The conquest of the Southern Song in 1279 completed another stage of expansion, but expeditions against Japan in 1274 and 1281 failed. Artists and scholars worked within these changing conditions, sometimes with limited access to office. His reign connects administrative accommodation with continuing conquest, asking how a ruler organized a diverse society without giving its inhabitants equal political standing.
summary.zh: 成吉思汗之孙忽必烈既依靠军队，也通过制度统治。1271年的元朝国号与大都都城，使其权力采取中国皇朝的形式。官署、礼仪和教育经过调整，服务于蒙古统治，而不同群体受到不平等对待仍是秩序的一部分。1279年征服南宋，完成又一阶段扩张；1274年、1281年对日本的远征却失败了。艺术家与士人在这些变化条件下工作，有些人的仕途机会受到限制。他的统治将行政上的适应与持续征服相联系，提出如何组织多样社会、却不给所有成员平等政治地位的问题。

title.en: Zhu Yuanzhang: rebuilding institutions and concentrating authority
title.zh: 朱元璋：重建制度与集中权力

summary.en: Zhu Yuanzhang founded the Ming in 1368 and pursued a government that reached from the emperor’s court into village registration and local schools. Early measures established county granaries and promoted Confucian education. The lijia system introduced in 1381 organized households for administrative obligations, making local communities part of the state’s machinery. These institution-building projects accompanied an increasingly concentrated form of rule. The purge of Hu Weiyong in 1380 and the abolition of the chief minister’s position drew more decisions toward the emperor. His reign therefore links rebuilding after dynastic conflict with coercion and political suspicion. Schools and registers tell one part of that story; the destruction of officials and their networks tells another.
summary.zh: 朱元璋1368年建立明朝，推动一种从皇帝朝廷延伸到乡村登记和地方学校的治理。早期措施兴设县级粮仓、推广儒学教育；1381年实行的里甲制度，把户籍与行政义务组织起来，使地方社区进入国家运转体系。这些制度营建伴随权力进一步集中。1380年胡惟庸案及丞相职位的废除，使更多决策直接归于皇帝。他的统治把王朝战乱后的重建与强制、政治猜忌联系起来：学校和簿册讲述其中一面，官员及其关系网络遭摧毁又呈现另一面。

title.en: Zhu Di: making authority visible in books, fleets and a capital
title.zh: 朱棣：书籍、船队与都城中的皇权

summary.en: Zhu Di seized the throne in 1402 after taking Nanjing from his nephew’s government. Violence against opponents accompanied a reign that also invested in ambitious cultural and infrastructural projects. The encyclopedia begun in 1403 gathered writings on an imperial scale, while Zheng He’s expeditions, beginning in 1405, carried court power into maritime networks. Construction in the north culminated in the formal move of the capital to Beijing in 1421. These undertakings depended on scholars, administrators, sailors and laborers whose work made imperial plans tangible. They also make the reign more than a succession of grand achievements: the question is how an insecure accession was followed by projects that organized knowledge, movement and space around a new center of rule.
summary.zh: 朱棣1402年从侄儿政权手中夺取南京，登上皇位。对反对者的暴力清洗，与规模庞大的文化及建设工程并存。1403年开始编纂的类书，以皇朝规模汇集著述；1405年起郑和船队的航行，则把朝廷权力带入海上网络。北方营建最终在1421年正式迁都北京。这些事业依赖学者、官员、船员和劳作者，将皇帝计划变成可见事物。理解这一统治，需要追问一次争夺得来的即位，如何继之以围绕新权力中心组织知识、交通和空间的工程。

title.en: Yu Qian: defending a capital, losing a court struggle
title.zh: 于谦：守住都城，败于朝争

summary.en: Yu Qian passed the jinshi examination in 1421 and developed an official career that included provincial administration. The capture of the Ming emperor in the Tumu crisis of 1449 brought him to the center of an emergency. As minister of war, he opposed abandoning Beijing, supported the new Jingtai emperor and organized the capital’s defense. Recruitment, supplies, weapons and training mattered alongside decisions at court: keeping a city required more than a declaration of resolve. The restoration of the captive emperor in 1457 reversed the political setting. Yu was executed on a treason charge. His career makes visible the precarious connection between serving a state in crisis and remaining secure under the ruler who followed.
summary.zh: 于谦1421年进士及第，仕途包括地方行政。1449年土木危机中，明朝皇帝被俘，使他进入应急决策中心。作为兵部尚书，他反对放弃北京，支持新立的景泰帝，并组织都城防御。募兵、军粮、武器和操练与朝廷决策同样重要，保卫一城不能只靠决心声明。1457年被俘皇帝复位，政治环境随之翻转，于谦以谋反罪名被处死。他的生涯揭示了一种不稳固的联系：危机中为国家效力，并不能保证在后来的统治者手中安全。

title.en: Wang Yangming: moral knowledge tested in action
title.zh: 王阳明：在行动中检验道德认识

location.label: Guizhou, representative setting of exile and reflection

labelI18n.en: Guizhou, representative setting of exile and reflection
labelI18n.zh: 贵州，贬谪与思考的代表地区

summary.en: Wang Yangming, also known as Wang Shouren, passed the highest civil examination in 1499. Punishment in 1506 sent him toward exile in Guizhou, where the insight associated with 1508 became a turning point in his philosophical account. He argued that moral knowing was not merely information stored before action: genuine understanding and conduct belonged together. His emphasis on innate moral awareness also challenged a learning practice centered only on accumulating external knowledge. Return to office brought military and administrative responsibilities, keeping his philosophy close to questions of public action. The resulting tradition asks a practical question: what does someone truly know if that knowledge leaves their conduct untouched?
summary.zh: 王阳明本名王守仁，1499年通过最高级文官考试。1506年受罚后，他被贬往贵州；与1508年相联系的悟道，成为其思想历程的转折。他主张道德认识并非行动前储存的一套信息，真实理解与行为本来相连。对内在良知的重视，也挑战了只向外积累知识的学习方式。重返仕途后，军事和行政职责使其哲学持续接触公共行动的问题。由此形成的思想传统提出一个切实追问：如果某种知识丝毫不改变人的行为，究竟能说已经懂得了什么？

title.en: Qi Jiguang: recruiting, training and adapting an army
title.zh: 戚继光：募兵、操练与军队调整

labelI18n.zh: 台州地区，沿海防御的代表地点

summary.en: Qi Jiguang’s military career connects coastal raiding with the practical work of building a fighting force. Assigned to Zhejiang in 1555, he recruited men from Yiwu in 1559 and organized mixed-weapon formations whose members had to act together. Fighting around Taizhou in 1561 tested that preparation. His later northern command, beginning in 1568, brought different conditions: frontier fortifications and coordination among infantry, cavalry, firearms and wagons. Support from Zhang Juzheng helped sustain this work, while the political changes after Zhang’s death preceded Qi’s transfer to Guangdong in 1583. Training manuals and defenses belong beside battles in this biography, because the effectiveness of an army depended on repeated practice, organization and material support.

title.en: Zhang Juzheng: making revenue and official performance count
title.zh: 张居正：财政与官员执行的改革

summary.en: Zhang Juzheng entered the examination elite in 1547 and became chief grand secretary in 1572. His reform agenda joined court authority to information about land, taxes and the performance of officials. A land survey begun in 1578 sought to improve the state’s fiscal records; the Single Whip measures promoted in 1581 combined obligations and increased the role of payments in silver. Such changes depended on how local officers registered households and assessed demands, not simply on a decree from Beijing. Zhang also supported frontier commanders, including Qi Jiguang. His death in 1582 was followed by attacks on his position and family, showing how a program associated with one powerful minister could become vulnerable to a reversal at court.
summary.zh: 张居正1547年进士及第，1572年成为首辅。改革计划把朝廷权威与土地、税收和官员办事情况的信息联系起来。1578年开始的清丈力图改进财政记录，1581年推广的一条鞭措施合并赋役，并扩大白银缴纳的作用。这些改变取决于地方官怎样登记、核定征收，不能只靠北京一道命令。张氏还支持包括戚继光在内的边防将领。1582年去世后，其政治地位与家庭遭到打击，显示与一位强臣紧密相连的计划，如何容易受到朝廷翻转的影响。
